title_en: Official Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Who Shall Bear the Debts of an Enterprise Established by an Administrative Unit or Enterprise Unit after Its Bankruptcy

articles.content_en:
2. After a branch enterprise established by an enterprise unit closes down, if such branch enterprise actually possesses independent legal person status, the debts incurred shall be repaid by the branch enterprise itself; if it does not possess independent legal person status, the unit that established the branch enterprise shall bear joint and several liability. If the branch organization established by the enterprise is a company, regardless of whether it possesses independent legal person status, it shall be handled pursuant to the Notice (Guo Fa [1985] No. 102).
August 29, 1987
